# The top-level commands and aliases of Claude Code 2.1.318, in the "Commands:" form of
# "claude --help". The implementer did not run claude. The names come from the command

# This list also has the hidden commands. It has only names and arguments, no descriptions.
# The output of "cl.sh --help" can replace this file. The parser reads the lines after
# "Commands:" that start with two spaces and a name. A "|" separates a name and its aliases.
